title: Pendant Alert Test Reliability Daily Trend
dataSources: Mobility-aid status (`mobilityaid:status`), wheelchair battery telemetry (`wheelchair:battery`), stairlift service records (`stairlift:service`), hearing-aid battery records (`hearingaid:battery`), pendant-alert tests (`pendant:test`).
app: Wheelchair battery telemetry, stairlift service records, hearing-aid battery reminders, and pendant-alert test logs streamed to Splunk HEC via apps, service portals, and caregiver forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pendant:test
| timechart span=1d avg(signal_strength_pct) as avg_metric by pendant_id
description: Trends signal strength percentage daily for pendant alert test reliability so slow deterioration is visible before it becomes an outage.
value: Daily trend lines are more useful than isolated checks because they show whether a problem is stable, worsening, or solved.
implementation: Retain at least a few weeks of history so you can compare normal decay with unusual drops.
visualization: Timechart of daily average signal strength percentage by device.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how pendant alert test reliability health changes day by day.
